setup.title: Setup checklist
setup.subtitle: What is configured in this deployment

email_api_key.title: Email API key
email_api_key.description: EMAIL_API_KEY sends verification, reset and invitation emails. Without it emails are only logged.

sender_domain.title: Verified sender domain
sender_domain.description: Until the sender domain is verified, the email service runs in sandbox mode. Check it in the Runsite dashboard.

email_verification.title: Require email verification
email_verification.description: Turn on REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION after the sender domain is verified.

billing_provider.title: Billing provider
billing_provider.description: BILLING_PROVIDER and its API credentials. Without them everyone stays on Free.

billing_price_ids.title: Price IDs
billing_price_ids.description: Monthly and yearly price, variant or product IDs for the active provider.

billing_webhook_secret.title: Webhook secret
billing_webhook_secret.description: Signing secret for the billing webhook endpoint.

google_oauth.title: Google sign-in
google_oauth.description: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET show the Google button on the login page.

storage.title: File storage
storage.description: S3 credentials and bucket enable file uploads, avatars and logos.

storage_delete_key.title: Storage delete key
storage_delete_key.description: Keys created by a Runsite template can delete objects. Set S3_DELETE_* only if the bucket is attached through a dashboard connection, whose key cannot delete; otherwise deleted files stay in the bucket (see the logs).

superadmin.title: Superadmin
superadmin.description: Set SUPERADMIN_EMAIL or run python -m app.cli create-superadmin.

impersonation.banner: You are signed in as {{email}} through impersonation.
